rationale: Builds directly on the current 9x512 reverse recurrent-tail best, but spends only the late wallclock on a blended suffix-only objective aligned to the validation stride. This is a structural training change, not another scalar sweep: it preserves the proven architecture and quant-aware endgame while shifting late updates toward the tokens that dominate final exact val_bpb.
title: Late Tail-Loss Blend On Reverse Recurrent Baseline
